newsitem.title: USA: GE Capital expands credit cards in Canada.
newsitem.headline: GE Capital expands credit cards in Canada.

text.p: GE Capital, a unit of General Electric Co., said Tuesday that it has launched its first Canadian GE Capital/MasterCard corporate card programme.
The programme broadens GE Capital's business-to-business payment products to its multinational client base, the company said.
Canada becomes the fourth country where GE Capital issues corporate cards by wholly-owned affiliates, after the United States, Britain, and Ireland, it said.
GE Capital's credit card currently services more than 1 million private label credit cards in Canada, the company said.
